verdict.rationale: ernd is a business credit card that pays rewards on AI-vendor spend. Running a product headlessly or in a CI pipeline is a software-execution axis, so the question is a category error for a payment card rather than a missing feature. The evidence describes no software runtime, CLI or execution mode that would make the axis apply, and the API probes hit an unrelated domain (developers.google.com), so they say nothing about ernd.
